title: Calculate shipping costs by cart weight
summary: A store quotes delivery based on both the cart subtotal and package weight. Select the applicable shipping tier and return the cost using the supplied thresholds and rules. Compute shipping using subtotal and package weight.
requirements: Free shipping if cart subtotal is at least freeOverCents.
Multiply each line weight and price by quantity.
hints: Check free shipping before weight tiers.
Use simple weight cutoffs to determine delivery charge.
